I replied to Tobias in a thread on their message in #central-team: "Thanks @tobias.rendle, noted. Expense reports are due this Friday, 16 Oct." The sim clock says it's Wednesday 14 Oct, so the Friday they mean is the 16th.

I didn't find anything about this deadline in GBrain. That search ran keyword-only, though, so it may have missed something. I didn't set a reminder because nobody asked for one.
